name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters National Tournament prize cards
notes: Only the "qualifying" tier of this prize product is represented here: "Millennium Shield", "Megasonic Eye", and "Yamadron" (each also independently available from 1999-06-01 via the Limited Edition Yugi/Kaiba/Joey packs; this record documents their earlier, genuine first availability at the February 1-21, 1999 National Tournament). The qualifying tier's fourth card, "Kanan the Swordmistress", is carried instead by the separate yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters-national-tournament-attendance-card record (same event, same date) to avoid duplicate-sourcing one card across two files. The top-placer tier ("Black Luster Soldier", "Zera the Mant", "Super War-Lion", "Fiend's Mirror" - one-of-a-kind metal trophy cards awarded in 1 to 4 physical copies each, never otherwise available) is deliberately excluded; see gap-ocg1999-nt-prize-top-tier.
